partners.name: Sama Owj Middle East Travel Agency
partners.description: Sama Owj Middle East is a Tehran-based travel agency providing domestic and international tours, flight ticketing, hotel reservations and tourist visa services. Its work emphasizes experienced travel professionals, modern technology and quality customer service.
partners.address: No. 177, Jordan Street, 1st Floor, Unit 102, Tehran, Iran
about: Sama Owj Middle East is a Tehran-based travel agency specializing in designing and operating domestic and international tours, booking flights and hotels in Iran and abroad, and assisting travelers with tourist visa services.

The agency brings together experienced travel specialists, technology-driven processes, and a commitment to service quality. It strives to follow developments in international tourism to improve the travel experience for its customers.
services: Hotel reservations in Iran and abroad

partners.name: Gohar Afarinan Farda — Gold & Jewelry
partners.description: Gohar Afarinan Farda is an Iranian gold and jewelry industry company offering consulting, professional training, product design, innovation and business development support, and collaborating with NovaNest on international business expansion.
about: Gohar Afarinan Farda specializes in gold and jewelry consulting, training and innovation. The company reports more than 20 years of industry experience, a team of over 30 specialists, 50+ successful projects, more than 1,000 satisfied clients and eight branches across Iran.

The company combines industry experience with modern technology and works with partner brands such as 18 Ayar, Baharan, Goharan, Nabat, Romis and Sarourian across jewelry design and production, product development, marketing and distribution.

As a NovaNest business partner, Gohar Afarinan Farda helps connect gold-industry entrepreneurs interested in expanding or relocating their businesses internationally, particularly to Canada. Together, we aim to support these entrepreneurs as they plan to establish and grow gold-related businesses in Canada.
services: Professional training and education for gold-industry businesses
